Sound effects in this folder are unmodified files from the uisfx library
(https://github.com/romainsimon/uisfx), redistributed via the npm package
@wubbleai/community-sfx 0.1.0. They are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0
(see LICENSE-AUDIO.txt). Files were renamed for their use in Duel Vault:
  draw.mp3 <- cinematic/swipe.mp3
  set.mp3 <- cinematic/drop.mp3
  activate.mp3 <- cinematic/unlock.mp3
  summon.mp3 <- scifi/level-up.mp3
  special.mp3 <- cinematic/level-up.mp3
  phase.mp3 <- cinematic/forward.mp3
  turn.mp3 <- cinematic/open.mp3
  click.mp3 <- cinematic/press.mp3
  win.mp3 <- cinematic/achievement.mp3
  lose.mp3 <- cinematic/error.mp3
  invalid.mp3 <- cinematic/invalid-drop.mp3
  move.mp3 <- cinematic/delete.mp3
  gain.mp3 <- cinematic/reward.mp3
